drivingQuestion: On Thursday, do they open slightly all day or fully all day?
outcomeNote: The dilemma is resolved in the next unit (taanit.sugya033).

segments.he: בַּשֵּׁנִי מַטִּין עִם חֲשֵׁיכָה וּבַחֲמִישִׁי כׇּל הַיּוֹם מִפְּנֵי כְּבוֹד הַשַּׁבָּת. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ, הֵיכִי קָתָנֵי: בַּשֵּׁנִי מַטִּין עִם חֲשֵׁיכָה, וּבַחֲמִישִׁי כׇּל הַיּוֹם — מִפְּנֵי כְּבוֹד הַשַּׁבָּת, אוֹ דִילְמָא: בַּשֵּׁנִי מַטִּין, וּבַחֲמִישִׁי פּוֹתְחִין כׇּל הַיּוֹם כּוּלּוֹ?
segments.en: § The mishna taught: «On Monday» they open the stores «a little at nightfall, and on Thursday» they are permitted to open the stores «all day, in deference to Shabbat. A dilemma was raised before» the Sages: «How is» this «taught,» i.e., what is the meaning of this ruling? Does it mean that «on Monday» the storeowners open their doors «a little at nightfall, and on Thursday» they likewise open their doors just a little, but do so «all day, in deference to Shabbat? Or perhaps,» the mishna means that «on Monday» they open their doors «a little,» but all day, «and on Thursday they open» their doors wide «the entire day?»
